title: Meet you in the Highlands.
scope: Key visuals · Pattern & icons · Medal concepts · Merchandise

title: The beginning of a design journey
scope: Graduation project · Print · Visual identity
summary: My final-year project at DPI Center, and the first milestone in my design journey. The project received First Prize in Design in the K35 class.
note: An academic project, presented with the original design boards and graduation photographs.

title: A nation behind its team
scope: Campaign key visuals · Advertising banners
summary: Creative support for Suzuki, Grab and Acecook during Vietnam’s AFF Suzuki Cup campaign. Working alongside the VNT team, I contributed key visuals and banners celebrating the national football team.
note: The work was shown on national television and in stadiums during the championship celebrations, as documented in my portfolio.

title: Everyday products, clear stories
scope: Social media · Product communication
summary: Social campaign visuals for four Panasonic product lines. Each asset responds to the product’s character while keeping a consistent connection to Panasonic’s brand and the Vietnamese market.

title: A playful side of Gery
scope: Social media · Product promotions · Campaign visuals
summary: Playful, youth-focused visuals for Gery in Vietnam. Bright product compositions and everyday humour bring the confectionery brand into social feeds and advertising.

title: A fresh perspective on laundry
scope: TVC campaign visuals · Asset adaptations
summary: Design support for Attack’s laundry campaigns in Vietnam, adapting creative assets for liquid and powder detergent promotions.
note: The gallery presents campaign frames and visual development from the portfolio. My contribution was design support, rather than ownership of the entire TVC production.

title: The character of coffee
scope: Product launch key visuals · Taste cards · Digital assets
summary: Product storytelling for The Coffee House Signature, from seasonal launches to specialty coffee. I supported digital design, developed key visuals and designed taste cards to give each coffee its own character.

title: A considered coffee experience
scope: Menu boards · Beverage & food menus · Six coffee taste cards
summary: A coordinated set of in-store materials for The Coffee House Signature. Menu boards, food and beverage menus, and taste cards for six specialty coffee lines were designed to support a clear, premium customer experience.

title: Coffee, connected
scope: Website redesign · Digital touchpoints
summary: Website design work during The Coffee House’s shift toward a more connected F&B experience. The project explores product discovery and digital touchpoints alongside delivery and in-store services.

title: Small details, one visual system
scope: UI components · Icon set · Membership visuals
summary: A visual refresh of The Coffee House app, updating key components, developing a new icon set and aligning the interface with the brand’s evolving digital direction.
note: I contributed to the redesign and visual system; I was not part of the original app development.

title: Built for the seller community
scope: Seller campaign assets · Promotional communication
summary: Campaign-led digital communication for Shopee’s seller community. These visuals introduce promotional programmes through a consistent, recognisable e-commerce design language.

title: Campaigns that invite action
scope: Campaign landing pages · Promotional programmes
summary: Landing pages designed to introduce Shopee seller promotions. Bold campaign identities, structured offers and clear content sections connect seller programmes with their audiences.
note: Full-length artwork extracted from the PDF is included below the overview where available.

title: One campaign, many touchpoints
scope: Omni-channel ad frames · GDN · Digital advertising
summary: Ad frames and digital assets for Shopee’s Omni-Channel Marketing programmes, supporting seller visibility and consistent brand expression across GDN and other placements.

title: A familiar brand, refreshed online
scope: Website redesign · Demos · Mockups · Delivery
summary: A contribution to Highlands Coffee’s website redesign, from early demos and mockups through final delivery. The work translates a familiar coffee brand into a refreshed digital experience.
note: The portfolio compares the previous website with the redesigned version.

title: Refreshing the daily coffee ritual
scope: Onboarding · Membership · Icons · Menu imagery · Banners
summary: A visual revamp of the Highlands Coffee app during its transition to a new agency. I refreshed onboarding, membership sections, product icons, menu images and in-app banners to bring the interface closer to the brand.
note: The agency defined the UX flow. My contribution focused on the UI and visual elements within that flow.

title: A colour for every craving
scope: Product categorisation · Colour system · Digital menu imagery
summary: Together with my manager, I worked on a renovation of Highlands Coffee’s product visuals. We reorganised product lines and assigned each category a distinct Pantone colour to build contrast, recognition and consistency.

title: A little more with every visit
scope: Loyalty experience · Zalo Official Account · Rewards
summary: Highlands Rewards brings a loyalty programme into Zalo Official Account. The mini app lets customers earn points and redeem rewards from Highlands Coffee and partners across different lifestyle categories.

title: Chill hè, one playful moment at a time
scope: Campaign game interface · Product visuals · Digital assets
summary: Digital design for the “Chill hè” promotional game. The campaign work connects a playful interface with product visuals and the wider Highlands Coffee brand experience.

title: A small card. A thoughtful gift.
scope: Giftcard landing page · Purchase interface · Product storytelling
summary: A dedicated landing page introducing Highlands Coffee Giftcards: a way to pay, share a drink or send a thoughtful gift. The interface presents card designs and guides customers through choosing and purchasing a giftcard.

title: The taste of summer
scope: Summer game interface · Campaign visuals
summary: A seasonal game interface for Highlands Coffee’s summer campaign. Product imagery and playful interactions are brought together within a consistent campaign identity.

title: A surprise worth discovering
scope: New-store activation · Zalo campaign · Promotional visuals
summary: A blind-box campaign created in collaboration with Zalo for new store openings. Interactive touchpoints, gifts and promotional visuals were designed to introduce new visitors to the brand and encourage an ongoing connection.

title: A café with a personal story
scope: Logo · Menu · Drink labels · Signage · Visual identity
summary: A complete brand identity for a former colleague from The Coffee House who opened his own café. A simple, retro-inspired and relaxed visual language carries across the logo, menu, labels, signage and other brand touchpoints.

title: Tea, wrapped in colour
scope: Tea packaging · Pack variations · Product presentation
summary: A tea packaging project for Ai Cha, presented through illustrated pack variations and a product gift-box composition. The work brings colour, illustration and packaging together as one family.

title: Rewards around the corner
scope: Loyalty app interface · Points · Rewards
summary: UI design for My Rewards, a loyalty platform connecting customers with casual local eateries. The app helps customers collect points and discover offers while giving vendors a way to build ongoing relationships.
note: Designed during the pandemic using an existing UX flow.

title: Insurance, closer to everyday life
scope: Insurance app interface · Plan discovery · Policy management
summary: UI design for My Hero, an integrated insurance app. The interface supports discovering, purchasing and managing different insurance products, from life insurance to motorbike and phone-screen protection.
note: My UI contribution followed a supplied UX flow.

title: Design for a growing community
scope: Event identities · Promotional materials · Event collateral
summary: Visual support for the ENC English Club at Hutech University. Event identities, promotional designs and community materials support the organisation’s educational mission and its focus on nurturing future leaders.

title: A quieter frame for living
scope: Self-initiated concept · Brand & digital exploration
summary: A self-initiated furniture design study, made for the joy of exploring. A quiet visual direction creates space to experiment with brand presentation, imagery and digital compositions.
note: Personal concept work, not a commissioned client project.

title: Off the clock, still creating
scope: Doodles · Painting · Personal illustration
summary: A collection of doodles, paintings and playful personal illustrations made in my free time. An open space for curiosity, drawing and enjoying the process.
